    n_cols: Number of columns in the plot grid.

  fig, axes = plt.subplots(n_rows, n_cols, figsize=(n_cols * 4, n_rows * 3))
  axes = np.ravel(axes)
  for ax, (name, p) in zip(axes, prior_samples.items()):
    p = np.asarray(p).ravel()
